Adventures

Go on an adventure

We offer different tours, for all tastes... Don't hesitate to come to the reception to book what you want.

Komodo Tour

Have you ever thought about seeing the dragons and the famous pink beach for real? You will go around Lombok, north Sumbawa and the Komodo Islands, not only to meet the dragons, but also to visit intact areas where the coral reef offers its best colors and wildlife... and the amazing whale sharks! For 3,700K per person, it includes 3 days, 4 nights sleeping on the deck, the entrance fees to the Komodo National Park, transportations, food and snorkelling material. If you need more comfort, you can choose a private cabin: 4,200K with a fan, 4,800K with air conditioning. It doesn't include the way back from Labuan Bajo (Flores). Departures usually on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
Check all infos and options

Rinjani Trek

You are rather sporty and you like hiking? This one is for you! For 2,450K per person, go on a 2 days, 1 night trek to reach the Rinjani, the famous volcano in Lombok. It will be sporty but you will admire exceptional landscapes! It includes the transportation from Gili Meno, food, tent, porters, and a first night prior to departure.
